value.rationale: The known equipotential circle creates an infinite family of indistinguishable ellipses under an unusually natural measurement. The new classification characterizes the entire nonidentifiability fiber, shows that only two extrema recover the axes generically despite loss of angular labels, and establishes a sharp minimum of two concentric radii for universal recovery.
